IGUI_VD_Help_connect: Press on the glowing dot and drag the thread through each next dot. Stay on the line and don't rush, or the thread tears.
IGUI_VD_Help_snip: Click the lit knot the moment its shrinking ring closes around it.
IGUI_VD_Help_wrap: Press on the marker and drag the bandage across the limb along the lane. Keep a steady pace.
IGUI_VD_Help_wrap_off: Press on the marker and peel the bandage off along the lane. Slow and steady.
IGUI_VD_Help_scrub: Hold the button and rub away every dirty spot before it creeps back. Go slow over the open wound.
IGUI_VD_Help_extract: Grab the end of each shard and pull it out slowly along the line.
IGUI_VD_Help_extract_bullet: Hold the probe still in the circle until you feel the bullet, then pull it out slowly.
IGUI_VD_Help_saw: Hold the button on the line and saw from one marker to the other. The blade drifts: keep it on the line and don't force it.
IGUI_VD_Help_hold: Hold the hot metal on the wound as it moves. Don't flinch.
IGUI_VD_Help_inject: Press on the glowing spot of the vein and hold still, then slide slowly along the vein to push the plunger.
